source_cards.title: 5 Different Ways to Mix Bass: Techniques from Five World-Class Mixers
source_cards.author: Warren Huart
findings: choose bass processing by musical role and section
clean-low, articulation and distorted-character layers are optional separable functions
check timing, polarity and mono behaviour before tone or dynamics judgments on combined layers
level-match processor comparisons and retain no-compression and fewer-layer baselines
preserve intentional note-to-note movement and artist identity
source_specific_numbers_not_presets: 800 Hz to 1 kHz articulation search region
limitations: no controlled listener study or statistics
five examples mediated by one publisher and not independent confirmations
no raw audio or complete reproducible manifests

knowledge_cards.claim: Select bass processing from the part's section role rather than the instrument label.
Clean-low, articulation and distorted-character layers are optional functions; preserve an unchanged or fewer-layer baseline.
Verify actual timing, polarity and mono behaviour before EQ or compression judgments on layered bass.
Output-loudness matching and accounting for saturation's existing peak control are required before judging added compression.

candidate_rules.name: role_conditioned_bass_layers_shadow_only
candidate_rules.when: rock or metal bass loses weight or note identity in a dense section
candidate_rules.change: label the missing function and test only its clean-low, articulation or distorted-character contribution
candidate_rules.parameter_range_and_origin: no automatic range; 800 Hz to 1 kHz and 60 to 100 Hz are source-specific search regions

candidate_rules.name: bass_layer_alignment_gate
candidate_rules.when: two or more bass sources, reamps or parallel returns are combined
candidate_rules.change: measure timing and audition explicit polarity states before tone or dynamics processing; do not auto-flip from one metric
candidate_rules.parameter_range_and_origin: derive any offset from actual project signals; no transferable delay or frequency value

experiments.material: Pena full-mix section with dense guitars and an eligible original bass source
experiments.A: current bass path with frozen parallel distorted return muted
experiments.B: identical mix with the same frozen return unmuted at one fixed gain
experiments.single_factor: frozen distorted-return contribution off versus on
experiments.loudness: retain raw measurement renders and create separate BS.1770-matched full-mix listening copies
experiments.success: same variant wins at least two of three blind Dmitry trials with no protected regression
blockers: baseline and parallel return not frozen
